summary: Apply the owner-provided 39-screen Gemini Pro UI/UX reference set across the tenant web application as a coherent system-wide design language, preserving existing business behavior and real data flows while matching reference layouts, navigation, tables, cards, filters, workspaces, responsive behavior and RTL presentation.
protectedReason: Owner explicitly requested a system-wide UI/UX redesign, not a local feature style change. The 39 supplied references include App Layout, Design System Atoms, Master Module Template and Data Table specifications, so the canonical shell, shared primitives, tokens, navigation and central styles must be extended once and then consumed by existing pages without changing business ownership or data behavior. The UI-ARCHITECTURE.md document defines the structural system rules that govern all redesign work.
